subject: Prompt/output purge request — Nimbus project (Data Erasure)
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah@cloudsprint.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge all prompt/response logs for project Nimbus (Data Subject Erasure)

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

We need Redwood to remove all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and associated service logs for the Nimbus pilot environment — customer request tied to a data subject erasure. Scope: all artifacts produced or stored under CloudSprint project id "nimbus-prod-001" across the last 24 months (2024-08-01 -> 2026-08-03).

Specifically we require:
- deletion of prompt inputs and generated text artifacts (prompt-output logs, KV-cache snapshots where derivable),
- deletion of trace and request logs for the project,
- confirmation that backups (S3 snapshots) containing these artifacts will be expunged or access-restricted per your retention policy,
- manifest of deleted items and cryptographic checksum/proof of deletion.

Attached is a CSV with the datastore identifiers we have (dsr_manifest.csv) — please confirm receipt and next steps. This is time sensitive; the compliance team expects an initial acknowledgment within one business day and evidence within three business days.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Privacy Lead, CloudSprint Inc.
[attachment: dsr_manifest.csv (text/csv, 42KB)]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Li <sarah@cloudsprint.io>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:02:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: purge all prompt/response logs for project Nimbus (Data Subject Erasure)

Sarah — thanks for the clear scope and the manifest. Acknowledged.

Summary / next steps (internal ops handoff):
1) I've opened a secure ops ticket (see JIRA-SEC-5421) and attached your CSV.
2) Neha (Security/Policy) and Marissa (Customer Ops) are looped to perform the purge runbook and produce the deletion manifest + checksum.
3) Our target for completion & evidence delivery is 72 hours after Ops start; we will provide an interim status in 24 hours. If CloudSprint needs an accelerated SLA, confirm and we can attempt same-day window depending on capacity.

Could you please confirm the canonical project id is "nimbus-prod-001" and that any archived exports outside Redwood's control (e.g., copies your team pulled) are out of scope? Once confirmed, Neha will schedule the deletion window (ops expects a quiet window of ~2 hours).

I will follow up with the Ops manifest when ready.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Li <sarah@cloudsprint.io>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:34:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: purge all prompt/response logs for project Nimbus (Data Subject Erasure)

On Tue, Aug 4, 2026 at 10:02 AM lauren_bishop@redwood.ai wrote:
> Sarah — thanks for the clear scope and the manifest. Acknowledged.

Hi Sarah — Neha here (Security / Data Ops). Quick tech notes and proposed execution plan: we validated the manifest and the canonical project id (nimbus-prod-001). Environment & residency: artifacts live in us-east-1 (primary) with point-in-time backups in our long-term vault (us-east-1).

Purge scope (what we will remove):
- prompt-input logs and generated outputs indexed by project id (prompt-output logs)
- any KV-cache snapshots and ephemeral caches associated with sessions covered in your manifest
- request traces, request metadata logs, and auxiliary indexing used by search/observability for the project id

What we will not remove (out of scope unless you confirm):
- customer-held exports you downloaded pre-erase,
- aggregated telemetry that contains no identifiers and cannot be mapped to the project id.

Execution plan:
- Ops runbook (SEC-RB-09) will execute staged deletion: live artifacts -> cache flush -> backup pruning -> snapshot tombstoning -> final manifest generation.
- Estimated downtime window: 2 hours (maintenance window).
- Expected evidence: erase_manifest_ops.json (structured list), crc32 checksums bundle, and a human-readable CSV manifest.

Attachments: preliminary op manifest (erase_manifest_ops.json) attached as a dry-run.

Please reply to confirm: (A) project id ok, (B) this scope is final, and (C) maintenance window preference (we propose Thu 2026-08-06 01:00-03:00 UTC).

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[attachment: erase_manifest_ops.json (application/json, 7KB)]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Li <sarah@cloudsprint.io>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@cloudsprint.io>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: purge all prompt/response logs for project Nimbus (Data Subject Erasure)

Thanks for the confirmation, Sarah — the team executed the runbook in the agreed window and attached the closure artifacts below.

What we did:
- Removed prompt/response artifacts and associated session caches for project id nimbus-prod-001 dated 2024-08-01 through 2026-08-03.
- Pruned backups and tombstoned snapshots that contained the scoped identifiers.
- Regenerated indices to remove references to deleted items.

Evidence attached:
- erase_manifest_20260805.csv (human-readable list of deleted object ids)
- proof_archive-checksum.txt (crc32 bundle of deleted objects)

We have also linked the ops ticket and the DocuSign deletion acknowledgement for your records (see related links). If CloudSprint's compliance team needs signed attestation on company letterhead, we can arrange that through legal — let me know.

Closing note: please confirm receipt of the manifest and whether you require any additional artifacts (logs of the runbook steps, S3 lifecycle change logs, etc.). Once you confirm receipt, we will close JIRA-SEC-5421.

Regards,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
